classification_note: Domains and descriptions are drafts based on table names, column names, and database comments. They have not been business-validated. No logical relationships are inferred.

domains.CRM and Contacts: People and organization records, contact details, activities, notes, and contact-management settings.
domains.Marketing Campaigns: Email and SMS campaign configuration, audiences, deliveries, recipient responses, and campaign statistics.
domains.Communications and Channels: Conversations, messages, communication channels, senders, and channel-provider settings.
domains.Automation and Workflows: Workflow definitions, stages, participants, transitions, and related events.
domains.Web Forms and Visits: Web forms and submissions, visitors, sessions, page views, and web analytics events.
domains.Learning and Membership: Courses, schedules and materials, membership products, access, and learning progress.
domains.Catalog and Commerce: Products, carts, order items, coupons, and related commercial data.
domains.Accounts and Access: Customer accounts, users, divisions, licenses, permissions, and authentication.
domains.Integrations: External-system connections, provider settings, synchronization, and record mappings.
domains.Analytics and Segmentation: Scores, profiles, segmentation rules, aggregates, and analytics support data.
domains.Data Import and Export: Data upload and export jobs, their parameters, results, and row-level logs.
domains.Reference Data: Geographic and other reference values used across the system.
domains.Privacy and Consent: Consent history and data-processing and communication-tracking settings.
domains.Logs and Operations: Technical logs, events, errors, notifications, diagnostics, and background-job health.
domains.Temporary and Archive Data: Tables that appear to contain backups, temporary extracts, or maintenance data; purpose should be confirmed.
